description: Prepares a Brief Battle request: brokers in the area compete for 72 hours with real units, ranked against DLD fair value. Returns a link the buyer opens to confirm and submit; nothing is sent until the buyer confirms.

area.description: Area name or slug: any of the Dubai areas from list_areas, e.g. "Dubai Marina", "jumeirah-village-circle", "JVC" or "Jumeirah Park". Brief Battle is open in every area.

must_haves.description: Free text for brokers. No emails, phone numbers or links.
